title: Why stewardship matters
title_zh: 审慎用药的目标
evidence: The speaker presents stewardship as a way to preserve effective treatment while reducing the unintended effects of antimicrobial use.
evidence_zh: 演讲者将审慎用药的目标概括为兼顾治疗效果，并降低使用抗微生物药物所带来的不良影响。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: A multisectoral action plan
title_zh: 跨部门行动计划
evidence: Zambia’s 2017 plan connects public education, surveillance, infection prevention, prudent use and research over a ten-year horizon.
evidence_zh: 赞比亚于2017年制定十年行动计划，覆盖公众教育、监测、感染预防、审慎用药和研究。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: Guidance for veterinary antibiotic use
title_zh: 兽用抗生素使用指南
evidence: The 2020 guidance addresses growth promotion in feed, routine preventive use and medicines important to human health.
evidence_zh: 2020年指南涉及饲料促生长用途、常规预防性用药，以及对人类健康具有重要意义的药物。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: Farm outreach and early reporting
title_zh: 养殖场宣传与早期报告
evidence: The presentation links farmer awareness with better husbandry, biosecurity, farm hygiene guidance and early reporting of animal disease.
evidence_zh: 课件将农户宣传与改善饲养管理、生物安全、养殖场卫生指南和动物疾病早期报告联系在一起。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: Linking guidance and surveillance
title_zh: 衔接兽医指南与监测
evidence: The speaker lists vaccination, national animal treatment guidance, veterinary regulation and surveillance in food animals among Zambia’s priorities.
evidence_zh: 演讲者列出的工作重点包括动物免疫、全国性动物诊疗指南、兽医执业监管和食用动物监测。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: Reaching farmers and community leaders
title_zh: 如何联系农户和社区领袖
evidence: Radio, meetings and training reached farmers, traditional and civic leaders, and agricultural input dealers.
evidence_zh: 广播节目、会议和培训面向农户、传统领袖、地方社区领袖及农资经销商。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: Training on prudent antibiotic use
title_zh: 审慎使用抗生素培训
evidence: The Zambia presentation documents a training activity devoted specifically to prudent antibiotic use.
evidence_zh: 赞比亚课件记录了专门围绕审慎使用抗生素开展的培训活动。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: Farm visits complement radio outreach
title_zh: 入户走访与广播宣传相结合
evidence: The outreach programme paired individual farm visits and group discussions with radio and training to promote husbandry and biosecurity.
evidence_zh: 宣传工作将养殖户走访、小组讨论、广播和培训相结合，推广饲养管理与生物安全做法。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: Sector-specific veterinary guidance
title_zh: 按养殖部门制定兽医指南
evidence: The presenter reports treatment guidance for poultry, fish, pigs, small ruminants, and beef and dairy cattle alongside regulatory work.
evidence_zh: 演讲者介绍了法规建设，以及面向家禽、水产、生猪、小反刍动物、肉牛和奶牛的诊疗指南。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: An integrated surveillance strategy
title_zh: 综合监测战略
evidence: The slide identifies Zambia’s national integrated AMR surveillance strategy as a basis for coordinating monitoring.
evidence_zh: 课件列出赞比亚国家综合抗微生物药物耐药性监测战略，作为协调监测工作的依据。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: Species-specific monitoring plans
title_zh: 分物种监测方案
evidence: The source lists Zambia’s 2020–2027 poultry monitoring protocol and separate 2024 protocols for domestic pigs and aquaculture.
evidence_zh: 资料列出赞比亚2020至2027年的家禽监测方案，以及2024年制定的家猪和水产养殖监测方案。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship in the animal and veterinary field in Zambia
author: Martha Sinzala
license: CPA CwPAMS toolkit: free to access, may be adapted for local use by Commonwealth healthcare institutions

title: How Vietnam framed its AMR research
title_zh: 越南如何界定耐药性研究重点
evidence: The 2019 research overview covered the reasons for antimicrobial use, surveillance, cross-sector transmission and intervention studies.
evidence_zh: 2019年的研究综述涵盖用药的原因、监测、跨部门传播与干预研究。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial use initiatives in agricultural food system in Vietnam
author: Trang Le; Sinh Dang-Xuan; Son Dang; Tran Minh Phu; Pham Duc Phuc; Hung Nguyen-Viet
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Studying how farmers make decisions
title_zh: 了解养殖户如何决策
evidence: A producer survey examined farmers’ first response to sick livestock and their reported reasons for antibiotic use.
evidence_zh: 一项生产者调查关注家畜患病时养殖户首先采取的行动，以及他们自述的抗生素使用原因。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial use initiatives in agricultural food system in Vietnam
author: Trang Le; Sinh Dang-Xuan; Son Dang; Tran Minh Phu; Pham Duc Phuc; Hung Nguyen-Viet
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Stewardship and smallholder livelihoods
title_zh: 审慎用药与小农户生计
evidence: Research in Thai Nguyen examined how smallholders and their animal-health networks used antimicrobials within household livelihood strategies.
evidence_zh: 太原省的研究关注小农户及其动物卫生服务网络如何在家庭生计安排中使用抗微生物药物。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial use initiatives in agricultural food system in Vietnam
author: Trang Le; Sinh Dang-Xuan; Son Dang; Tran Minh Phu; Pham Duc Phuc; Hung Nguyen-Viet
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Pig health across the value chain
title_zh: 生猪价值链中的动物健康
evidence: The VIDA-PIG project linked husbandry, farmer drug use, residues and resistance with evaluation of interventions across farms and the pork value chain.
evidence_zh: VIDA-PIG项目结合饲养管理、农户用药、残留和耐药性研究，并在养殖场及猪肉价值链中评估干预措施。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial use initiatives in agricultural food system in Vietnam
author: Trang Le; Sinh Dang-Xuan; Son Dang; Tran Minh Phu; Pham Duc Phuc; Hung Nguyen-Viet
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: An Ecohealth stewardship project
title_zh: 生态健康视角的审慎用药项目
evidence: The team described an initiative to develop and evaluate a shared strategy for more prudent antimicrobial use in people and animals.
evidence_zh: 研究团队介绍了一个开发并评估共同策略的项目，推动人和动物审慎使用抗微生物药物。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial use initiatives in agricultural food system in Vietnam
author: Trang Le; Sinh Dang-Xuan; Son Dang; Tran Minh Phu; Pham Duc Phuc; Hung Nguyen-Viet
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Farmer training in chicken production
title_zh: 家禽生产中的农户培训
evidence: The ViParc trial in Dong Thap combined farmer training, farm health planning and diagnostic support in its intervention design.
evidence_zh: 同塔省ViParc试验的干预设计结合养殖户培训、养殖场健康规划和诊断支持。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial use initiatives in agricultural food system in Vietnam
author: Trang Le; Sinh Dang-Xuan; Son Dang; Tran Minh Phu; Pham Duc Phuc; Hung Nguyen-Viet
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Policy context in the 2019 presentation
title_zh: 2019年课件中的政策背景
evidence: The authors place Vietnam’s earlier AMR action plans alongside the 2018 livestock law and veterinary medicine rules in force at the time.
evidence_zh: 作者将越南早期耐药性行动计划、2018年畜牧法及当时的兽药管理规定列为政策背景。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial use initiatives in agricultural food system in Vietnam
author: Trang Le; Sinh Dang-Xuan; Son Dang; Tran Minh Phu; Pham Duc Phuc; Hung Nguyen-Viet
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Research gaps identified in 2019
title_zh: 2019年识别的研究缺口
evidence: The researchers found surveillance more prominent than intervention studies and called for stronger implementation of the existing framework.
evidence_zh: 研究人员认为监测比干预研究更为普遍，并指出已有政策框架的落实仍需加强。
source: Antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial use initiatives in agricultural food system in Vietnam
author: Trang Le; Sinh Dang-Xuan; Son Dang; Tran Minh Phu; Pham Duc Phuc; Hung Nguyen-Viet
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: An Italian poultry-sector trend
title_zh: 意大利家禽业用药变化
evidence: Unaitalia reports broiler antibiotic use falling from 20.09 to 0.70 mg of active ingredient per kg of live weight between 2015 and the 2021/22 endpoint. The corresponding turkey figures were 31.12 and 2.57.
evidence_zh: Unaitalia报告，2015年至2021/22期末，肉鸡每千克活重对应的抗生素活性成分用量由20.09毫克降至0.70毫克；火鸡由31.12毫克降至2.57毫克。
source: Antibiotics reduction in the Italian poultry sector
author: Unaitalia

title: Totals can hide different trends
title_zh: 总体下降掩盖了类别差异
evidence: For 2011–2019, the industry series reports an overall decrease of about 80% by active ingredient per kg live weight, while some individual classes increased.
evidence_zh: 按每千克活重对应的活性成分计，行业数据在2011至2019年总体下降约80%，部分药物类别的用量仍有上升。
source: Antibiotics reduction in the Italian poultry sector
author: Unaitalia

title: Prevention on poultry farms
title_zh: 家禽养殖场的预防工作
evidence: The case study identifies chick transport, vaccination practice, cleaning and farm biosecurity as elements of its prevention approach.
evidence_zh: 这一案例把雏鸡运输、免疫管理、清洁与养殖场生物安全列为预防工作的组成部分。
source: Antibiotics reduction in the Italian poultry sector
author: Unaitalia

title: Housing and nutrition in prevention
title_zh: 禽舍环境与营养管理
evidence: The poultry industry case describes monitoring housing conditions and addressing nutrition as complementary parts of flock management.
evidence_zh: 这一家禽产业案例将禽舍环境监测和营养管理视为相互配合的饲养措施。
source: Antibiotics reduction in the Italian poultry sector
author: Unaitalia

title: Options for poultry stewardship programmes
title_zh: 家禽审慎用药项目的可选措施
evidence: The author places monitoring of use, education, prescribing guidance and vaccination alongside biosecurity and resistance surveillance.
evidence_zh: 作者将用量监测、教育、处方指导和免疫与生物安全及耐药性监测一并列为项目措施。
source: Efforts to reduce antimicrobial use in poultry in low- and middle-income countries
author: Moodley, Arshnee
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Fit prevention to the production system
title_zh: 让预防工作适应生产模式
evidence: The presentation contrasts commercial urban poultry production with lower-input free-range systems to show why interventions need local adaptation.
evidence_zh: 课件比较城市商业化家禽生产与低投入散养体系，以说明干预措施需要适应当地生产条件。
source: Efforts to reduce antimicrobial use in poultry in low- and middle-income countries
author: Moodley, Arshnee
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Listening to poultry value-chain actors
title_zh: 了解家禽价值链参与者的困难
evidence: A value-chain mapping exercise identified feed quality, finance, disease burden and access to poultry management information as production challenges.
evidence_zh: 价值链调查识别出饲料质量、融资、疾病负担以及难以获得饲养管理信息等生产难题。
source: Efforts to reduce antimicrobial use in poultry in low- and middle-income countries
author: Moodley, Arshnee
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Training gaps among agricultural suppliers
title_zh: 农资经销商的培训缺口
evidence: In the Uganda case, 58% of surveyed agrovet respondents reported never receiving AMR training, suggesting a gap for education programmes.
evidence_zh: 在乌干达案例中，58%的受访农兽资经销者表示从未接受耐药性培训，显示教育项目有切入空间。
source: Efforts to reduce antimicrobial use in poultry in low- and middle-income countries
author: Moodley, Arshnee
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: What can limit policy implementation
title_zh: 影响政策执行的因素
evidence: The Kenya example points to dispensing practices, weak enforcement resources and gaps affecting informal providers as barriers to implementing policy.
evidence_zh: 肯尼亚案例指出，药品销售实践、执法资源有限及针对非正规服务提供者的政策缺口会妨碍实施。
source: Efforts to reduce antimicrobial use in poultry in low- and middle-income countries
author: Moodley, Arshnee
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: Designing an intervention with communities
title_zh: 与社区共同设计干预措施
evidence: The proposed behavioural study begins by defining the desired change, then works with local actors to design and test possible interventions.
evidence_zh: 这项拟议的行为研究先界定预期改变，再与当地参与者共同设计并检验干预方案。
source: Efforts to reduce antimicrobial use in poultry in low- and middle-income countries
author: Moodley, Arshnee
license: CC-BY-4.0

title: A new denominator for the UK indicator
title_zh: 英国用量指标更换分母
evidence: VMD adopted a harmonised estimate of animal population weight. It advises distinguishing the resulting mg/kg series from the earlier mg/PCU series.
evidence_zh: 英国兽药管理局采用统一的动物群体体重估算方法，强调新区间的毫克/千克指标与此前的毫克/群体校正单位指标口径有别。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2024
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: UK sales in 2024
title_zh: 英国2024年销售量
evidence: UK veterinary antibiotic sales for food-producing animals were 15.6 mg/kg in 2024. On the harmonised measure, this was 57% below 2014.
evidence_zh: 2024年英国食用动物兽用抗生素销售量为每千克15.6毫克。按统一口径计算，比2014年低57%。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2024
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: Voluntary sector usage data
title_zh: 行业自愿提供的用药数据
evidence: VMD distinguishes medicines prescribed or administered from medicines sold. Industry-supplied usage data covered at least 85% of the sectors shown.
evidence_zh: 英国兽药管理局区分开具处方或实际使用的药物与销售量。课件所示各行业的企业自愿报送用药数据覆盖率至少为85%。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2024
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: Reading sales and resistance together
title_zh: 结合阅读销量与耐药指标
evidence: VMD displays a sales indicator alongside a combined indicator of resistance in broilers, turkeys and pigs to compare changes over time.
evidence_zh: 英国兽药管理局将销售指标与肉鸡、火鸡和生猪的综合耐药指标并列展示，便于比较长期变化。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2024
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: What clinical surveillance represents
title_zh: 临床监测代表什么
evidence: The 2024 report cautions that diagnostic submissions are selective. Results describe the submitted material and cannot be extrapolated to the full UK animal population.
evidence_zh: 2024年报告提示，送检病例存在选择性，结果描述的是已送检材料，不能直接推广至英国全部动物群体。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2024
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: Three questions in the UK-VARSS series
title_zh: 英国VARSS课件涵盖哪三个问题
evidence: The 2025 slide set draws on the annual UK-VARSS report and separates antibiotic sales, use and resistance as three reporting topics.
evidence_zh: 2025年课件源于年度UK-VARSS报告，分别讨论抗生素销售、使用和耐药性三个主题。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2025
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: UK sales in 2025
title_zh: 英国2025年销售量
evidence: In 2025, UK sales for food-producing animals reached 15.9 mg/kg, 2% above 2024 and 56% below 2014 on the reported measure.
evidence_zh: 2025年英国食用动物兽用抗生素销售量为每千克15.9毫克；按报告口径，比2024年高2%，比2014年低56%。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2025
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: Highest-priority antibiotics in 2025
title_zh: 2025年最高优先级抗生素销售量
evidence: Sales of highest-priority critically important antibiotics for food-producing animals were 0.07 mg/kg in 2025, 82% below 2014.
evidence_zh: 2025年英国食用动物最高优先级关键抗生素销售量为每千克0.07毫克，比2014年低82%。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2025
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: Interpreting sector coverage
title_zh: 如何理解行业数据覆盖率
evidence: The UK animal industry supplied usage figures voluntarily. Reported coverage reached at least 83% in the sectors shown for 2025.
evidence_zh: 英国动物生产行业自愿报送用药数据。课件所列各行业2025年的数据覆盖率至少为83%。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2025
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: Comparison across two-year periods
title_zh: 跨两年期比较综合指标
evidence: The UK series combines results from broilers, turkeys and pigs over two years and presents them alongside a harmonised sales indicator.
evidence_zh: 英国数据系列把肉鸡、火鸡和生猪两年间的监测结果合并，与统一口径的销售指标并列展示。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2025
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated

title: Coverage of clinical surveillance
title_zh: 临床监测的覆盖范围
evidence: Diagnostic submissions can be selective. The 2025 edition also adds verified cat and dog results shared by the University of Liverpool.
evidence_zh: 诊断送检样本带有选择性。2025年版另纳入利物浦大学提供并经核验的猫和犬监测数据。
source: UK Veterinary Antimicrobial Resistance and Sales Surveillance (UK-VARSS) 2025
author: Veterinary Medicines Directorate
license: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated
